name: Disneyland Cafe Orleans Roasted Chicken or Petite Steak with Potatoes/Rice (No Blackening Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Cafe Orleans (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Ordering the roasted chicken breast or steak entrée (or the Kids' Grilled Chicken & Rice) without Cajun pepper seasoning gives you a lean, freshly cooked table-service meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request your chicken or steak prepared plain without Creole/Cajun pepper rub, and swap garlic-parmesan Pommes Frites for plain fries, mashed potatoes, or white rice.
watchOuts: Standard Pommes Frites are tossed in minced raw garlic and herbs—ask for plain fries or rice instead
